*/*Fully furnished 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, Single family Victorian with spacious backyard. @#@
Fully-equipped with everything you need (or specify a few things you don't want included, and we can move them out before you move in).
All utilities included except PG&E (gas and electric). Includes gigabit fiber internet, wired ethernet at two desks, and commercial-quality WiFi.
Monthly housekeeping and cleaning included. Additional service available, at your cost.
Driveway and garage parking included - space for two cars. EV charging available, please inquire. Large garage also has space for lots of storage of furniture, boxes, bikes, etc.
Family-friendly neighborhood, close enough to all the action of the Castro and Mission District, but far enough away that the neighborhood is quite, safe, and clean! A terrific park for little kids is just across the street - it has a toddler-sized playground, plus big flat areas for riding bikes or kicking balls. A bigger park, with bigger play structure, is a couple blocks up the hill. Basketball and tennis courts at both parks. "Slow Sanchez" street is a few blocks away - perfect for strolling with dogs or kids.
Walk down 24th Street one block to the start of wonderful Noe Valley, chock-full of family-friendly restaurants, shops, a Whole Foods supermarket, and more. Or, head up to Diamond Heights where you'll find Safeway, a popular Dim Sum restaurant, and more.
The Muni 48, 35, and 24 buses all stop within 2 blocks. The 24th St BART station is ~12 blocks away on the 48 bus line - or have a nice walk there through Noe Valley.
Dog or cat may be OK - please inquire!
Rental period may be flexible - Available on month-to-month basis - no long-term lease required, though may be available.

3358A 16th Street, San Francisco, CA
Rent: $7,495 / month
WELCOME HOME TO THE HEART OF SF CULTURE & CONVENIENCE
Step into luxury and style with this newly transformed, full-floor residence situated in one of San Francisco’s most vibrant and desirable corridors. Perfectly positioned on 16th Street between Dolores and Church, this high-end home places you steps from the best food, culture, and greenspace the city has to offer.
Whether you are stepping into a new chapter or upgrading your San Francisco lifestyle, this residence offers an elevated urban living experience.
RESIDENCE HIGHLIGHTS
Brand-New High-End Remodel: Experience the feel of a brand-new home with premium hardwood flooring, fresh architectural finishes, and pristine interiors throughout.
Gourmet Chef's Kitchen: Custom cabinetry, sleek quartz countertops, and a full suite of state-of-the-art, unused stainless steel appliances.
Spacious 3BR Layout: Generously sized bedrooms featuring modern lighting and built-in closet storage.
2 Full Designer Bathrooms: Elegantly tiled full baths with modern fixtures, glass enclosures, and spa-inspired finishes.
Bright & Airy Interiors: Expansive floor plan designed to optimize natural light and modern city living.
UNBEATABLE LOCATION & NEIGHBORHOOD
Dolores Park (3 Blocks Away): Enjoy sunny afternoons, breathtaking skyline views, and weekend picnics at SF’s iconic neighborhood hub.
Valencia Street Corridor (3 Blocks Away): World-class dining, artisanal coffee shops, boutique shopping, and vibrant nightlife right outside your door.
Transit & Commuter Friendly: Excellent access to Church St. MUNI lines, 16th St. BART, and tech shuttle stops for seamless transit anywhere in the Bay Area.
